how: EP11 hand-check helper, written AFTER reading extractor output (post hoc, not the scorer).

rows.first_cell: Give the availability endpoint its own p95 alert, separate from the api-wide one.
1. Find the latest nightly backup in object storage
2. Copy the backup to the restore account in eu-west-1
3. Restore the database from the backup
4. Check row counts against the production snapshot
5. Start api against the restored database and make a test booking
Total time to a working api
Messaging API: SMS to Japanese numbers
One-time sign-in codes sent as SMS
Alert on the age of the oldest message on the notifier queue, not only on queue depth.
Enforce a minimum lease time of 30 s in code, so a config change cannot set it lower.
Add per-worker send rate to the "Sorrel / notifier" board, so one silent worker shows at a glance.
Check clock sync on every notifier node in the weekly node health report.
Never drop an index in the same deploy that builds its replacement: drop the old one in a later deploy, after the new one is ready.
Run index builds on tables over 10 million rows outside 09:00 to 21:00 JST.
Give the availability endpoint its own p95 alert, separate from the api-wide one.
Build the refund idempotency key from the refund id, never from the run's start time.
Make the scheduler alert instead of restarting a job that moves money.
Write down in the payments runbook how to pause a job that moves money.
Alert when booking starts from new visitors fall more than 40 % below the same hour last week.
Run every new firewall rule in log-only mode for 24 hours before it blocks or challenges anything.
